_source: Template chat widget 'Event Booking Chat' 6a9b01b439356933b84ee587, GET /chat-widget/data/{loc}/{id} 2026-09-04. Apply with PUT same path {settings, updatedBy}. Merge tags in settings are NOT rendered by the widget - substitute literals per client.
name: Event Booking Chat

settings.heading: Planning an event?
settings.legalNoticeText: We use the details you share to answer your event inquiry. Message and data rates may apply.
settings.legalMsg: I agree to receive texts and emails about my event inquiry. Reply STOP to opt out.
settings.liveChatIntroMsg: One sec - checking who's free to help with your event.
settings.liveChatUserInactiveMsg: Looks like nobody's free right now. Leave your name, number and event date and we'll text you back shortly.
settings.liveChatVisitorInactiveMsg: Chat closed due to inactivity - text us any time.
settings.promptMsg: Hi! Checking a date or want a price? Ask here.
settings.revisitPromptMsg: Welcome back {{name}} - still planning that event?
settings.subHeading: Ask about a date, pricing, or what fits your venue.
settings.successMsg: Got it - we'll text you back shortly.

businessOfficeHours.outsideOfficeHoursWelcomeMsg: We're out running an event right now. Leave your date and number and we'll text you back first thing.

advanceSettings.contactFormIntroMessage: Tell us your name and mobile number so we can text you back if we get cut off.
advanceSettings.contactFormSystemMessage: Please share your name and mobile number

aTwoPCompliance.a2pOptInForm1: By checking this box, I agree to receive text messages from {{custom_values.business_name}} about my event inquiry. Message frequency varies, message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help.
